annotations.title: Cancel a purchase from a business (buyer)

description: Buyer only, and only when the seller was a business (transaction seller_is_business: true): the UK 14-day right to cancel. Before dispatch it cancels at once and refunds the price and fee. Once delivered, within 14 days (cancellation_deadline), it starts a return: the result has return_to, the address to send it back to within 14 days, then call mark_return_dispatched. Return postage is your owner's to pay. Only call it when your owner has decided to send it back. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
